blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur— Police arrested a suspect in a shooting incident believed to be a case of road rage that left a nurse dead and his daughter wounded in Bangued, Abra, on Friday night, Oct. 23. The suspect was arrested at around 1:30 a.m. on Saturday, along Felix Tuanquin Street in Poblacion, Tayum, Abra, following a hot pursuit operation by personnel of the Bangued Municipal Police Station and the 1st Provincial Mobile Force Company. Police said the shooting occurred at around 9 p.m. on the Bacsil-Angad road in Bangued as the victims and some of their family members were heading […]...
